label: The CI coverage guard is wired: skill-doc-frontmatter.yml runs check-skill-doc-frontmatter.sh . --coverage on PRs to main and pushes to main/skilled/** for skill references/assets docs, failing closed if the guard is missing; the guard's five-field contract still excludes version, so CI checks skill-doc frontmatter coverage but cannot see any doc's stored version.

sk-doc-script-tests.yml runs on every push/PR to main and skilled/** and executes run-script-tests.sh, whose loop globs test_*.py only; test_validation_switch.py in that glob invokes frontmatter-version.mjs gate (--from-manifest) and apply (--paths), so the engine's CLI modes are exercised in CI against fixtures, while the .mjs engine suite remains unrun by any workflow and no CI step inspects real documents' stored versions. Partial supersession of the iteration-2 dead-end's broad gloss; its .mjs-specific claim stands.

Fresh non-markdown search across .github, .skilled/hooks, .opencode/scripts and the sk-doc scripts tree re-confirms no automated surface invokes frontmatter-version.mjs verify or fleet apply; the only non-test, non-doc references are the post-edit router (gate mode, presence+format) and the tests themselves.

The frontmatter-templates asset carries literal version values (1.0.0.0, 1.7.0.0, 0.1.2.0, and similar) as the authoring surface where a doc's first version value is typed by hand; with apply as the only automated writer, every version value originates from a template literal or an operator command, never from a pipeline.

Q5 final inventory with both CI legs now source-cited: writers - apply only, operator-run; automated checkers - post-edit gate (skill-tree versioned docs, presence+format), package validators (command-run, presence+format), CI coverage guard (five-field contract, version excluded), CI script tests (engine fixtures only); verify - no caller anywhere.
